finding: CG-08-E2-01 would still pass if premerge-check stopped running crap-score at the merge. The last merge-story asserts only exit 0, the state done, and the merged commit. A merge without the gate also gives these three results, and the report in .current-work/crap-score/ already exists from the gate-check step before it. The docstring also names the Scenario Outline 'A gate that cannot measure at the merge blocks the story on both ways', but the test blocks the story only in the gate-check step and never runs exit 3 at the merge. A scratch copy of the test that stops the stack before the merge showed that both work today: premerge-check printed GATE CANNOT MEASURE: crap-score, merge-story exited 1, and the story was blocked. Fix: in the test, assert that merged.stdout holds the line 'PASS semantic-gates: crap-score passed for ST-0350'. Either remove the merge Scenario Outline from the docstring, or add the leg of the scratch copy before the last resume-gates.
